        Write the email this person would actually send: their voice,
        their concern, one ask. A client, not a colleague — they do not know
        the firm's internals, they know their business and what they need.

[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Evan Doyle, Chief Financial Officer at Stonebridge Property Group. Formal, lender-minded, wants dates and commitments. Ongoing concerns: keeping the business moving.

[[ ## situation ## ]]
From: Evan Doyle
To: Gabriel Fontes, Lucia Mendes
Subject: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Action Required

Gabriel, Lucia,

We are revisiting the CAM reconciliation disputes for the tenant in question. This is a priority matter that needs to be resolved before we can close out the current cycle.

Please provide a status update and a clear timeline for resolution. I need specific dates for when we can expect the final numbers and any supporting documentation to be in hand. We cannot afford further delays on this.

Evan

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Evan Doyle
Subject: Re: CAM Reconciliation Dispute – Action Required

Evan,

Thanks for the nudge. We are on this and have a clear path to resolution.

Status: The CAM reconciliation for the disputed cycle is in progress. I am finalizing the numbers and the supporting documentation now.

Timeline: I will have the final figures and all supporting documentation in hand by Wednesday EOD. That is our drop-dead date, and we will meet it.

If anything shifts between now and then, I will flag it immediately. Otherwise, expect the complete package in your inbox by then.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

[[ ## contacts ## ]]
Gabriel Fontes, Lucia Mendes
